content.en: Regulates discarded electronic and electrical equipment (EEE) under EPR mandates, revised extensively in 2022 to introduce tradable EPR certificates and digital portal registration.
content.hi: Regulates discarded electronic and electrical equipment (EEE) under EPR mandates, revised extensively in 2022 to introduce tradable EPR certificates and digital portal registration.

content.en:
• Applies to all manufacturers, producers, refurbishers, dismantlers, and recyclers.
• RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances): Limits hazardous heavy metals: Lead (Pb), Mercury (Hg), Hexavalent Chromium (Cr VI), Polybrominated Biphenyls (PBBs) to 0.1%, and Cadmium (Cd) to 0.01% by weight.
• Mandatory recycling targets managed through the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) online EPR portal.

question.en: Under the RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) provisions in India's E-Waste Rules, what is the maximum permissible concentration of Cadmium?
question.hi: Under the RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) provisions in India's E-Waste Rules, what is the maximum permissible concentration of Cadmium?

explanation.en: Cadmium has a stricter limit of 0.01% by weight in homogeneous materials, whereas Lead, Mercury, and Hexavalent Chromium are capped at 0.1%.
explanation.hi: Cadmium has a stricter limit of 0.01% by weight in homogeneous materials, whereas Lead, Mercury, and Hexavalent Chromium are capped at 0.1%.
